summary: Stop embedding every user in the notification settings page: rule forms now hold only named recipients and search a paged GET /settings/notifications/recipients. Add notifications.RecipientDirectory and core.ModuleOptions.NotificationRecipientGroups to limit who can be picked; NewNotificationRoutingService takes the directory and Recipients is replaced by SearchRecipients/RecipientsByIDs. Rule-named people outside the directory are refused on save and skipped on delivery. Give navbar controls one 36px round style with even spacing.
